title: Adopt descriptive Xcode project-definition terminology
description: Replace AppleProjectSpec naming in Vaporize's active Swift, Pkl, test-support, CLI-copy, and engineering surfaces with names that identify the typed Xcode project-definition responsibility.
resolution: Vaporize now consumes XcodeProjectDefinitionCore from the xcode-project-definition package and uses XcodeProjectDefinition throughout active implementation and tests. The canonical Pkl module is XcodeProjectDefinition.pkl; AppleProjectSpec.pkl remains a deprecated compatibility shim for existing project declarations.

verification: swift package dump-package passed against the renamed dependency and product.
swift package resolve completed and refreshed Package.resolved.
All 30 changed Vaporize Swift files passed swiftc frontend parsing.
The owning Vaporize CLI copy package passed its generated-resource test on Windows.
The complete Xcode definition build is macOS-scoped; on Windows it stops in upstream pkl-swift before reaching the renamed sources.
historicalContent.compatibilityBoundary: Historical release evidence and closed receipts retain the terminology they originally recorded. Only the Pkl filename shim remains in the active product surface.
